name: @voxgig/sdkgen-validpack
description: Validation targets for the Voxgig SDK Generator: seeded test data for an API, and a mock server that serves it.
author: Richard Rodger (http://richardrodger.com)

scripts.test: node tools/comment-gate.cjs && node tools/dep-gate.cjs && node --test tools/dep-gate.test.cjs && node --enable-source-maps --test test/*.test.js

_peer_comment: The components import @voxgig/sdkgen and @voxgig/apidef by name, so both
are declared. Peers rather than dependencies: a consumer has them already,
through sdkgen, and a second copy at another version is the one outcome
The sdkgen floor is the oldest published version this suite has been run
against, and `engines.sdkgen` in sdkgen-package.json repeats it: a suite
memfs is required by @voxgig/sdkgen/testkit at run time and reaches no
consumer of sdkgen, so it is declared here, pinned to sdkgen's own pin.
@types/node is for the components, which read the model with Node's types.
yaml is how the suite reads the definitions it checks records against.
`private` because nothing is published yet: a project links a checkout.
Remove it with the first release.
